categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Changyou Environmental Protection Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of polymer composite materials and lightweight sandwich materials. Its main products include wind turbine nacelle covers, lightweight sandwich materials for wind turbines, molds for nacelle covers, and rail transit vehicle components. The company serves mainly the wind power and rail transit industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced resin impregnation molding technology, self-developed embedded parts integrated molding tooling, fiber foam composite molding, automated glass fiber mold forming, fiber product surface engraving, lightweight structural design, and glass fiber solid composite technology. It also employs semi-automated robotic arms for precise embedded part positioning and has developed intelligent CNC programming and processing technologies for special core materials. The production process emphasizes quality control and efficiency improvements through automation and innovative materials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are leading wind turbine manufacturers such as Goldwind, Envision Energy, Yunda, Mingyang Smart Energy, and Sany Heavy Energy, which together hold a dominant market share in China's wind power sector. The company also serves major rail transit manufacturers, primarily China CRRC. The wind power industry accounts for over 97% of the company's revenue, with rail transit and other sectors making up the remainder.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates production bases across multiple provinces in China including Jiangsu, Hebei, Hunan, Inner Mongolia, Yunnan, Sichuan, Gansu, Guangxi, and Heilongjiang, enabling nationwide market coverage. Its sales are concentrated domestically within China, with no significant overseas operations reported.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Changyou operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing composite materials and components such as nacelle covers and sandwich materials that are supplied to wind turbine and rail transit original equipment manufacturers (OEMs). It is a key component supplier within the wind power and rail transit equipment manufacturing supply chains.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on technological innovation and R&D to maintain its industry leadership, with 108 patents including 25 invention patents. Key R&D initiatives include developing new nacelle cover designs, rapid programming and processing of special core materials, intelligent production lines, advanced drilling equipment for wind turbine blades, and environmentally friendly recyclable materials. It plans to expand into new composite material applications such as aerospace, military, and unmanned aerial vehicles, supported by a new R&D center and talent acquisition.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of composite material products and components to OEM customers in the wind power and rail transit sectors. The company follows a direct sales model, with revenues recognized upon delivery and acceptance of products. It also earns income from molds and other composite material products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading first-tier enterprise in the domestic wind turbine nacelle cover market, with strong relationships with major OEMs. It competes with other composite material suppliers in the wind power and rail transit sectors but holds a significant market share and is recognized as a strategic partner by key customers. Specific competitors are not named in the report.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.05 billion, a 20.53% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 105.23 million, up 27.39%. Total assets reached RMB 1.52 billion, growing 21.39% from the previous year. The company has shown steady growth driven by increased sales volume and expanded production capacity, including new subsidiaries and production bases.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through comprehensive one-stop, full-chain, customized solutions for wind turbine nacelle covers, leveraging extensive design data and modular product design to shorten development cycles and reduce costs for customers. Its advanced manufacturing technologies ensure high product quality, durability, and performance, contributing to improved wind turbine efficiency and reduced levelized cost of electricity. Strong customer partnerships and localized production bases enhance delivery speed and cost efficiency.
